question.question: What do Melanie's family give her?
question.baseline_note: gate2 improved-defaults local token-F1; h2h deterministic attempt 0.0 ('Love and support')

diagnosis.class: B (write-time drop), with a rank-33 in-store substitute that cannot win the answer stage
store_evidence: Gold fact is NOT in the frozen conv-26 store: no memory entry contains the D18 strength/motivation statements. Full harness_state scan (119 entries, title+content) finds zero Melanie notes with 'strength'/'motivation' phrasing about family.

Gold source: session 18 (2023-10-20 chat), D18:9 = m_0009 'They're really amazing. Wish I was that resilient too. But they give me the strength to keep going.' plus m_0011 'They're my biggest motivation and support.'

Write-time drop is an extraction-selection miss, NOT chunking: session-18 import (job import_75094c90476e98ccf7c226be) ingested ONE chunk covering all 24 records (coverage: 24/24 evidence records, excludedLines=[]), but the accepted proposal created only 4 memories (son accident, Grand Canyon roadtrip, trail walk, camping-what-she-loves) citing m_0001/3/5/6/7/15-21 - the m_0009-m_0014 attribute/sentiment turns were never cited by any memory.

Nearest in-store substitute: melanie_married_five_years_as_of_june_2023 ('Her husband and kids keep her motivated; she says she feels most alive and happy during family moments') - lexical rank 33/50 on the raw question (score 0.4081; matched [melanie, family, her] at body weight), OUTSIDE the 24-entry deterministic window.

Decoy that wins the answer stage: melanie_move_family_support_july_2023 (rank 15, in-window) - 'they helped out and showed lots of love and support' - a surface-perfect completion of 'What do Melanie's family give her?' with the wrong content.

Scorer floor: official locomo_token_f1 drops a/an/the/and and Porter-stems; 'love and support' scores 0.0 vs gold. Only 'Motivation' (0.667), 'Motivation and support' (0.5) or 'Strength and motivation' (1.0) pass; 'Motivation, love and support' = 0.4 fails.
diagnosis.write_time_fix_needed: Extraction must capture speaker-attribute statements ('X gives me Y' / 'X keeps me motivated'), not only dated events. Owned by the update-drop/UI-distillation workers (imp4-updatedrop). Same pattern likely explains q18/q26/q77/q144 ('not mentioned' answers).
